about_the_game:
This game is a 2D pixel style aircraft carrier deck management game.

You will become a ground crew member with different functions on the deck of China's third aircraft carrier, the Fujian, commanding the transportation, refueling, ammunition loading, takeoff, and landing of carrier based aircraft.

The enemy doesn't know when they will appear, and all you need to do is prepare the fighter jets on the deck as soon as possible.

This is a fast-paced time management game. Time is life, you need to make decisions quickly and give accurate commands. Don't repeat the indecisiveness of a commander who lost three aircraft carriers in five minutes.

There are many limitations to the operation of aircraft carrier decks, such as scheduling conflicts between catapult 1 and the forward lift, usage conflicts between catapult 3 and the landing area, and so on. You need to follow these rules to properly arrange all aspects of aircraft preparation, takeoff, and landing.

Level content:

The game contains multiple fictional historical combat missions. Helps you familiarize and understand game operations and core gameplay in the early stages.

In addition, it also includes three different difficulty levels of endless modes, where enemies will attack wave after wave, and you can see how long you can lead this giant ship to persist.

Featured gameplay:

After each wave of enemies is cleared, a random gain reward will appear, which helps to complete battles more efficiently in subsequent waves.

In addition to enhancing the work efficiency of ground personnel, the participation and assistance of new models of fighter jets such as J35 and KJ600 can also be obtained.

Minimum:
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: 2.3GHZ CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX10 compatible graphics card Shader model 3+
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c

  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

short_description: Wear uniforms of various colors and become a deck ground crew member. Dispatch various types of aircraft on the carrier deck to ensure smooth takeoff and landing.
